**Who reconstructed it**, if the source says:

Only solves whose scramble and moves are published can be added, and only
once `pnpm solve:check "<scramble>" "<moves>"` says the cube ends solved. We
keep what the World Cube Association's public results say about a solver
(name, country, competition, date, time) and nothing else.
